subject: Request: One-time sandbox stretch + complimentary pilot credits for OrbitAI
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@orbitai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-time sandbox stretch + complimentary pilot credits for OrbitAI

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — our engineering team is excited and we want to move faster on the integration, but we hit two blockers on our side: (1) a 3-week delay in our data access pipeline which has pushed back our evaluation runs, and (2) Procurement needs a PO and formal SOW before they can sign onto paid usage.

Because of those delays we will run out of the pilot credits you previously provided before we can complete the workload validation. Would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of complimentary credits (we estimate ~300k tokens based on the attached usage snapshot) and a 30-day sandbox extension so we can finish the integration and sign a PO?

This is an important pilot for us — OrbitAI is in advanced talks with two enterprise customers that would require Redwood in production if the pilot is successful. If helpful I can share the customer timelines (sensitive) under NDA.

Attachments: OrbitAI_usage_snapshot.csv (current token burn / projected need)

Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that makes approval easier.

—Sara
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Engineering, OrbitAI
sara.nguyen@orbitai.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: One-time sandbox stretch + complimentary pilot credits for OrbitAI

Markus — forwarding OrbitAI request. Key points below and my ask at the end.

Summary:
- Request: one-time complimentary top-up (~300k tokens) + 30-day sandbox extension.
- Reason: engineering/data access delay + procurement needs PO/SOW before committing spend.
- Strategic rationale: high-velocity pilot; two downstream enterprise opportunities (close timelines in Q4) — likely >$120k ARR if pilot goes well.

My recommendation (Deal Desk + CS):
- Approve a one-time credit of 300,000 tokens (not recurring).
- Grant a 30-day extension to sandbox window tied to a signed SOW/PO within 30 days of credit application.
- Condition: CS to monitor usage and engage if token burn > 80% of the credit within 14 days.
- Legal to push an addendum: one-time credit, non-refundable, no precedent beyond ORB-472.

Attached: OrbitAI_SOW_draft.pdf (procurement requested), OrbitAI_usage_snapshot.csv, exec_approval_memo.txt (internal summarizing projected ARR).

If you approve, I'll coordinate with Lauren and CS to (a) issue credit, (b) apply extension, (c) get legal to draft a short amendment. If you want a call I can be available 11–12.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: One-time sandbox stretch + complimentary pilot credits for OrbitAI

Markus — quick note on cost/impact: 300k tokens as a one-off is ~equivalent to ~$2.1k at current blended unit economics for this workload (they are using larger context long-form runs). The potential upside if this converts is material given the two enterprise prospects Monica mentioned.

Operational asks if you approve:
- Revenue Ops / Deal Desk to apply temporary credit code and log it against ORB-472.
- CS to set up usage alert and a sync cadence with OrbitAI (week-of and then weekly until conversion).
- Legal to prepare addendum language (one-time credit, PO due within 30 days).

Please confirm OK or provide edits.

Thanks, Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: One-time sandbox stretch + complimentary pilot credits for OrbitAI

Thanks for the context and recommendation. I approve the one-time concession with the following explicit conditions — please treat as final: 

1) Credit: issue a single, non-recurring credit of 300,000 tokens to OrbitAI (ORB-472).
2) Extension: 30-day sandbox extension from the date the credit is applied.
3) PO/SOW: OrbitAI must submit a signed PO or countersigned SOW within 30 days of credit application. If PO is not received by day 30, the extension and remaining credits are withdrawn.
4) Monitoring: CS to set an 80% usage alert and report to me if consumption pace indicates potential overrun.
5) Legal: prepare a 1-paragraph addendum that captures the one-time nature and prevents setting precedent. Send the addendum to OrbitAI procurement and a copy to me.
6) Bookkeeping: Deal Desk to tag this with deal_id ORB-472 and record the concession reason: "PO procurement delay — one-time pilot support to preserve conversion path."

Lauren/Monica/Jonas: please execute. Monica — send OrbitAI a short note confirming the approval and the conditions (copy me). Include the SOW draft and a link to the PO template.

I am ok with this as a one-off — do not make this a standard offering.

—Markus
